tours.name: QuantMuse Architecture Overview
tours.description: A comprehensive tour of the QuantMuse quantitative trading system architecture

steps.title: Welcome to QuantMuse
steps.description: QuantMuse is a comprehensive quantitative trading system that combines traditional financial analysis with AI/ML capabilities. Let's explore its architecture.

steps.title: Core Architecture Pattern
steps.description: The system follows a dual-layer architecture: Python for data processing/AI and C++ for high-performance trading execution.

steps.title: Python Data Service Layer
steps.description: The data_service/ directory contains the main Python components for data fetching, analysis, and AI integration.

steps.title: C++ Trading Engine
steps.description: The backend/ directory contains the high-performance C++ engine for order execution and risk management.

tours.name: Data Flow Pipeline
tours.description: Follow the flow of market data from source to trading decision

steps.title: Market Data Sources
steps.description: QuantMuse fetches data from multiple sources: Binance for crypto, Yahoo Finance for stocks, and Alpha Vantage for financial data.

steps.title: Data Processing Pipeline
steps.description: Raw data is processed, cleaned, and enriched with technical indicators and features.

steps.title: Quantitative Factor Analysis
steps.description: The system calculates various financial factors (momentum, value, quality, volatility) for stock selection.

steps.title: AI-Powered Analysis
steps.description: Machine learning and NLP components provide additional insights through sentiment analysis and LLM integration.

tours.name: Trading Strategy Framework
tours.description: Explore how trading strategies are implemented and executed

steps.title: Strategy Architecture
steps.description: The strategy framework provides a base for implementing various trading strategies with consistent interfaces.

steps.title: Risk Management System
steps.description: Critical risk management components validate trading decisions and enforce risk limits.

steps.title: Order Execution Engine
steps.description: High-performance order execution system handles trade placement and monitoring.

steps.title: Backtesting Framework
steps.description: Comprehensive backtesting system validates strategies against historical data.

tours.name: AI/ML Integration
tours.description: Deep dive into the artificial intelligence and machine learning components

steps.title: Feature Engineering
steps.description: Machine learning feature engineering creates predictive variables from market data.

steps.title: ML Models
steps.description: Various machine learning models for prediction and classification tasks.

steps.title: Natural Language Processing
steps.description: NLP components analyze news and text data for market sentiment and insights.

steps.title: Large Language Model Integration
steps.description: Integration with OpenAI GPT and other LLMs for advanced market analysis.
